gpu_state.note: Instantaneous nvidia-smi readings before the warm-up, after it, and after the last timed process; they describe the GPU around the run, not clock stability during it.

warmup.workload: cuda resident, 8-bit, input_sparse_n67108864, 100 reps per process

matrix_parameters.in_process_warmup_rule: per path: max(warmup, ceil(target_seconds * 1000 / probe median ms)), probe = one untimed stoquant bench process with the base warmup and reps
matrix_parameters.cpu_avx2_threads_rule: stoquant default: logical processors in the inherited affinity mask (Windows; online processors elsewhere)
matrix_parameters.invocation_scheme: every trial reuses base invocation 0; identifiers per repetition are copied from each stoquant bench configuration

statistics_method.pooled: median and IQR over all measured repetitions of all trials
statistics_method.speedup_point: baseline pooled median / candidate pooled median
statistics_method.speedup_range: [baseline min trial median / candidate max trial median, baseline max trial median / candidate min trial median]
statistics_method.spread_ratio: max trial median / min trial median
statistics_method.spread_p90_p10: p90 / p10 of the trial medians

claim_rules.verdict: verdict is 'faster' when baseline trial-median minimum / candidate trial-median maximum > 1, 'slower' when baseline trial-median maximum / candidate trial-median minimum < 1, and 'inconclusive' otherwise
claim_rules.direction_supported: direction_supported: verdict is not 'inconclusive' and boundary_inversion is false (host-origin pooled median is not below the pooled median of any resident path)
claim_rules.magnitude_supported: magnitude_supported: direction_supported and both the candidate and the baseline have spread_p90_p10 <= 1.25 (90th over 10th percentile of trial medians, numpy method 'linear')
claim_rules.claim_supported_rev2: claim_supported_rev2: verdict is not 'inconclusive', boundary_inversion is false, and both the candidate and the baseline have spread_ratio <= 1.25 (maximum over minimum trial median)
claim_rules.baselines: every path is measured against a policy-matched CPU baseline: resident, resident-graph, host-origin, and CPU gpu-origin paths against the CPU comparator (host-host); CUDA gpu-origin against CPU gpu-origin of the same transfer policy. Pinned paths add vs_pageable against their pageable twin; CUDA gpu-origin adds a descriptive vs_comparator with no claim flags

bootstrap.rule: 95% percentile bootstrap: resample each path's trial medians with replacement, independently, 10000 times from numpy.random.default_rng(31); the statistic is the baseline median of resampled trial medians over the candidate median of resampled trial medians

affinity.applied_to: driver process before any benchmark or probe process; inherited
